proposed_widenings.name: duration-scoped conditional effect application for activated abilities
proposed_widenings.justification: The item is a normal charge-based activation with a timed sense grant, but the granted sense only applies while the bearer is peering through the gem during that 10-minute window. The current surface can gate a passive or gate activation itself, but cannot express a timed activated effect whose applicability is conditional during its duration.
proposed_widenings.evidence: For the next 10 minutes, you have Truesight out to 120 feet when you peer through the gem.

notes: Did not author content/magic_item_gem_of_seeing.dhall because any current encoding would be misleading: passive loses the charge-timed activation, while plain activation lies about unconditional Truesight for the full 10 minutes.
